summary: [standards] evidence_problems accepts a test when the source contains 'fn name(' : it does not require #[test], no #[ignore], or that the test is in the workspace run, which scenario .11 states as a Then. I checked by hand: all 15 named tests carry #[test] and ran green here. The 'preview equals commit' row names purge-only and digest tests (atip_planjcs_01, _09, _10); artifacts move, migrate, ledger compact and tier age have their commit-equals-preview tests elsewhere (migrate.rs, tier_age.rs, paging.rs) and are not listed. Blast radius: a renamed-to-ignored or deleted #[test] over a kept fn keeps .11 green.
